receipt.local.text: Burauzarka ta rubuta abin da aka aika yayin rubuta ta: babu abin da ya bar wannan na'urar.
receipt.inCloud.text: An aika tattaunawarka zuwa gajimare don rubuta wannan amsa.
receipt.unknown.text: Ba a ajiye bayanan burauzarka na abin da aka aika yayin rubuta ta ba.
receipt.proof.text: Takardar shaida tana nuna yadda aka yi wannan amsa, ba kalmominta ba ko kaɗan: kowa zai iya samun ta. Hujja tana ƙara buƙatar da amsar, ga waɗanda aka yarda su karanta su.
receipt.checkAt: Kowa zai iya duba su a {address}.
